metadata.description: Function-hook plugins for Claude Code: a self-opening task band and multi-step next-prompt sequences.

plugins.name: panneau-taches
plugins.description: A task band above the prompt that opens by itself: Claude plans multi-step work, ticks each task as it goes, and the band closes when everything is done.

plugins.name: next-steps-sequence
plugins.description: A variant of next-steps: tick several suggested next prompts, in the order you choose, and run them as a sequence, one step per turn.
